If you want to experience authentic local food in Quy Nhon
Jul 2026 • Family
The dining experience here was absolutely spot on. The food arrived piping hot, beautifully presented, and seasoned to perfection. The flavours were wonderfully balanced—subtle yet rich, with the tender, juicy meat pairing brilliantly with the thick, savoury sauce that instantly hit the spot. You can really tell the ingredients are fresh, as the natural sweetness shone through. Enjoying it all in such a cosy atmosphere made for a thoroughly relaxing meal. It’s a proper gem, and I’ll definitely be coming back
